text:
pat: Quick thought — lattice batching looks promising but we need to lock semantics for "start-deadline" vs "completion-deadline". I think enqueue should carry a start-deadline (max time to begin execution).
rachel: +1 for start-deadline. Completion deadlines are tricky because execution time varies.
pat: Proposed minimal envelope: model, version, seq_bucket, deadline_ms_rel, tenant, opt_in_prefix_hash. No payload.
lee: If we do deadline_rel as start-time, compute slack = deadline - now - est_service. Use slack to decide fastpath vs batched.
anya: Prefetch must be opt-in and privacy-preserving (hashed prefix, per-tenant salt). Also add opt-out config for regulated tenants.
rachel: Fairness note: heavy tenants can monopolize specific seq_bucket cells. Add per-cell proportional credits and a reserve for smaller tenants.
pat: Preemption: allow preempting partially filled batches for urgent arrivals. Need cancelable prefetches and TTL on warmups.
lee: Implement est_service as catalog + EWMA corrections. Expose seq_bucket profiles.
anya: Observability: record cell_id, batch_fill_ms, preempt_count, canceled_prefetches, post-prefetch_kv_hits.
rachel: Experiment plan: cohort A = baseline, B = lattice no-prefetch, C = lattice + opt-in prefetch. Metrics: p50/p95/p99, kv_miss_rate, batch_efficiency, tenant_fairness_index.
pat: Action items: pat draft RFC (enqueue proto), rachel telemetry plan, lee credit sim, anya prefetch API + privacy. Will open RFC and tag reviewers.
lee: small nit — use relative ms for deadline to avoid clock skew.
anya: also require server sanity check on deadline and reject unrealistic values.
pat: thanks — locking this in and will post RFC link when ready.
file_notes: short architecture thread; no title per agents.md
